name: znetwork_dplay_select_tcp_ip_provider_and_enum_sessions
description: zNetworkDPlay::SelectTcpIpProviderAndEnumSessions builds a forced TCP/IP DirectPlay compound address, initializes that provider, and optionally enumerates sessions until DPERR_CONNECTING clears.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.

Binary Ninja reconstruction remains limited because MSVC EH cleanup and stack-built GUID/DPCOMPOUNDADDRESSELEMENT copies render as literal dword/byte temporaries in HLIL; assembly and typed DirectPlay SDK structures validate the source contract.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/HLIL for 0x48bbe0 validates the __fastcall addressString/skipSessionEnumeration arguments, DPAID_ServiceProvider and DPAID_INet compound address elements, DPSPGUID_TCPIP provider GUID, two IDirectPlayLobby3A::CreateCompoundAddress calls, temporary zNetworkDPlayServiceProviderInfo display name forced TCP/IP, SelectServiceProviderAndInitConnection call, skip path returning 1, and enumeration loop while EnumSessionsForCurrentApp returns DPERR_CONNECTING.

Native smoke znetwork_dplay_select_tcp_ip_provider_and_enum_sessions_smoke verifies the compound address element GUIDs, sizes, data pointers, provider initialization data copy, TCP/IP provider flags, skip path, and DPERR_CONNECTING retry behavior before a successful enumeration result.
